title: Retail Installment Contracts: Payment-Activity Allowance on Hardship Deferrals
content:
On a contract under Retail Installment Contracts, the payment-activity allowance for a hardship extension agreement counts the payments posted on the contract, returned or not, in the rolling **6** months ending on the signing date — payments dated later than the same calendar day 6 months before the signing date (the last day of that month when that day does not exist) and on or before the signing date.

| Payments posted in that period (returned or not) | Payment-activity allowance |
|---|---|
| at least 5 | the tier's maximum installments deferred by one extension |
| 1 to 4 | one installment |
| none | zero |

Every posted payment counts, whatever its channel and whether or not the bank later returned it.

**Hypothetical counts (signing date 10 November).** Payments posted on 10 May, 2 June, 1 July, 3 August and 9 October: the 10 May payment is not later than 10 May, the same calendar day 6 months before, so it falls outside; the other four count, and the allowance is one installment. A fifth payment inside the period, even one later returned, would make the allowance the tier's per-request maximum. With no payment in the period, the allowance is zero.
